name: LED lighting retrofit
cost_note: Pays back in roughly 1-3 years at industrial tariffs. VERIFY
source_name: US DOE - Consumer guide to energy-efficient lighting
note: Share of site electricity saved: lighting is typically 10-20% of a factory's load and LEDs use 40-60% less than legacy lamps. Range is an analyst estimate. VERIFY against an audit

name: Compressed-air leak repair
cost_note: Mostly labour and an ultrasonic leak survey. VERIFY
source_name: US DOE - Minimize compressed air leaks (tip sheet)
note: Compressed air is often ~10% of industrial electricity and 20-30% of compressor output is commonly lost to leaks. Only applies if you run compressors. VERIFY

name: Refrigerant leak checks and repair
cost_note: Quarterly leak checks; cost is a technician visit. VERIFY
source_name: US EPA - Stationary refrigeration leak repair
note: Refrigerant top-ups equal what leaked. Range is an analyst estimate of recoverable leakage. VERIFY

name: Switch LPG heating to electric
cost_note: Equipment and installation; depends on the process temperature. VERIFY
source_name: Analyst estimate (12.8 kWh/kg LPG at 80% efficiency vs 95% electric)
note: Net of the extra electricity at your grid factor: on a coal-and-gas heavy grid this can raise emissions. A heat pump (COP above 3) changes the answer for low-temperature heat. VERIFY

name: Buy renewable certificates (I-REC or equivalent)
cost_note: Certificate price per MWh varies by market. VERIFY
note: Lowers market-based Scope 2 only; location-based is unchanged. Range is the share of your electricity you cover. VERIFY availability in your country
